name: Pistol Squat
description: Balancing on one leg with the other held straight out in front, squat down as low as you can control, then stand back up on the same leg.

source.title: NASM Exercise Library: Single-Leg Squat
source.note: Described in our own words. Stick-figure approximation.

setup: Stand on your left leg, right leg lifted straight in front of you.
Arms reach forward to help you balance.

prescription.note: Advanced. Master the two-leg squat first; to build up, lower to a chair or hold a doorframe, and only go as deep as you control.

keyframes.name: Stand on your left leg
keyframes.cue: Right leg straight out in front, arms forward.

keyframes.name: Lower
keyframes.cue: Sit down and back on your left leg, right leg straight out.

keyframes.name: Stand up
keyframes.cue: Push through your left foot to stand.

keyframes.name: Both feet down
keyframes.cue: Lower your right foot and rest.
